models.name: marketo__email_sends
models.description: Each record is a sent email in Marketo to a user. The email send activity timestamp should be in the valid range of the email template's valid time range. Valid range is from when the version was created or last updated until the next version's update, and the latest version's range stays open (i.e., 2099-01-01 00:00:00.000).

columns.name: action_result
columns.description: The outcome of a specific action performed within the Marketo platform.

columns.name: activity_id
columns.description: The ID of the activity.

columns.name: activity_rank
columns.description: Assigned rank for a given email_send_id, determined by ascending order of activity_timestamp. Earliest activity_timestamp gets rank 1.

columns.description: The timestamp the email was sent.

columns.name: activity_type_id
columns.description: The ID of the activity type.

columns.description: The ID of the email's campaign run.

columns.name: choice_number
columns.description: The choice number of the current step that triggered the activity.

columns.description: The inferred ID for the email sent. This is a surrogate key generated from primary_attribute_value_id, campaign_id, campaign_run_id, and lead_id. Use dbt utils package to generate the surrogate key.

columns.name: email_template_id
columns.description: The ID of the email's template.

columns.name: was_bounced
columns.description: Whether the email send bounced. Set to True if the email bounced, False if it did not.

columns.name: was_clicked
columns.description: Whether the email send was clicked. Set to True if the email was clicked, False if it was not.

columns.name: was_delivered

columns.description: Whether the email send resulted in the user unsubscribing. Set to True if the email was unsubscribed, False if it was not.

columns.name: is_operational
columns.description: Whether the email send was operational.
